LESSON: KUSOMA 6.2.1 KUSOMA KWA KINA TAMTHILIA

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: USALAMA NYUMBANI Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli za Ujifu
Topic 6.2: Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya maudhui na dhamira katika fasihi ili kuipambanua
2. kutambua maudhui na dhamira katika tamthilia
3. kujadili maudhui na dhamira katika tamthilia

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya maudhui na dhamira katika fasihi ili kuipambanua
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya maudhui na dhamira katika fasihi ili kuipambanua. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua maudhui na dhamira katika tamthilia
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua maudhui na dhamira katika tamthilia. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kujadili maudhui na dhamira katika tamthilia
   In simple words: practise until you can kujadili maudhui na dhamira katika tamthilia. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya maudhui na dhamira katika fasihi ili kuipambanua

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya maudhui na dhamira katika fasihi ili kuipambanua
2. kutambua maudhui na dhamira katika tamthilia
3. kujadili maudhui na dhamira katika tamthilia

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
